set.approach: Mill Creek North Rim is reached from the Mill Creek trailhead by a trail that crosses a log bridge and then heads up the hill toward the obvious wall. Tiger Stripe is the wall above the large ledge above Tick Farm. A Climb Before It's Time begins from the top of Liger, and follows the crack that rises over the Liger belay.

review.notes: Area pages: access and wall; route page: start. No confirmed descent.
